tool_args.rationale: The observed displacement scales with the signed input step and reverses sign over time. A fitted sum of two exponential modes captures that reversal while preserving the unchanged output for a zero step. Fresh confirmation will test the proposed mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The normalized step response changes sign with horizon, which a single exponential cannot reproduce.
Already acquired; the resulting seven nonzero-step observations support fitting a four-parameter temporal response before purchasing more data.
It does not resolve the relevant temporal mechanism.
